description: 急诊分诊时，用最短的话说清最危险的信息：症状、时间、呼吸、过敏和用药。

targetChunks.en: I need to see a doctor right away.
targetChunks.note: right away = 立刻；急诊开场，越简短越好。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I need to see a doctor right away.

targetChunks.en: I've got a sharp pain in my chest.
targetChunks.note: sharp pain = 刺痛；描述疼痛性质，帮助分诊。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've got a sharp pain in my chest.

targetChunks.en: It started about an hour ago.
targetChunks.note: 急诊一定要说清时间；比 It just started 具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It started about an hour ago.

targetChunks.note: 危险的红色信号，必须优先说。
用药前必须说；急诊会写在腕带上。
挂号/分诊时出示；也可以说 Here's my ID.
急诊等待时间差异大；问清好安排。
问分诊优先级；护士会按症状判断。
be on medication = 正在服药；说清长期用药。

targetChunks.en: Can someone call my emergency contact?
targetChunks.zh: 能联系我的紧急联系人吗？
targetChunks.note: emergency contact = 紧急联系人；手机没电/无法说话时用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can someone call my emergency contact?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 能联系我的紧急联系人吗？

targetChunks.note: discharge instructions = 出院医嘱；离院前必须问清。

roleplay.promptZh: 你胸口刺痛、呼吸困难，来到急诊分诊台。用最短的话说清症状、时间、过敏和用药，并问清等待和后续。
roleplay.promptEn: You arrive at ER triage with chest pain and trouble breathing. Give the key facts quickly and ask about wait time and next steps.
goals: 说清时间、过敏和长期用药
问清分诊和出院注意事项

script.speaker: you
script.en: I need to see a doctor right away. I've got a sharp pain in my chest.
script.zh: 我需要马上看医生。我胸口刺痛。

script.speaker: you
script.en: It started about an hour ago. I'm having trouble breathing.
script.zh: 大概一小时前开始的。我呼吸困难。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I'm allergic to penicillin. I'm on blood pressure medication. Here's my insurance card.
script.zh: 我对青霉素过敏。我在吃降压药。这是我的医保卡。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Have a seat. We'll call you shortly.

script.speaker: you
script.en: How long is the wait? Is this urgent?

script.speaker: other
script.en: We're prioritizing you. A doctor will see you soon.
script.zh: 我们会优先处理你，医生很快来看。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Thank you. Can someone call my emergency contact?
script.zh: 谢谢。能联系我的紧急联系人吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Of course. We'll ask for the number at registration.

script.speaker: you
script.en: And what are the discharge instructions?
